description: Scrape property listings from Property Finder (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, Egypt). Provide URLs or use city + purpose filters.

country.description: Country to search in (used only when no URLs are provided).
country.sectionDescription: Used only when Start URLs are empty.
country.title: Country

fetch_full_details.description: When enabled, the scraper fetches each listing's detail page to retrieve the complete image gallery, full description, floor plans, and all extended fields. Disables if you only need basic listing info. Adds 1 HTTP request per property.
fetch_full_details.title: Fetch Full Details (All Images + Extended Data)

ignore_url_failures.description: Continue running even if some URLs fail after max retries.
ignore_url_failures.title: Ignore URL Failures

max_items.description: Maximum number of unique properties to scrape.
max_items.title: Max Items

max_retries.description: Maximum retry attempts for each failed request.
max_retries.title: Max Retries Per Request

startUrls.description:
Property Finder URLs to scrape. Supports:
- SEO landing pages (e.g. /en/buy/dubai/apartments-for-sale-marina.html)
- Sitemap URLs (e.g. /sitemaps/dubai-buy-0.xml)
- Sitemap index (/sitemaps/index-sitemap.xml)
startUrls.sectionDescription: Enter Property Finder URLs. Leave empty to use city + purpose filters below.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Property Finder Scraper
